subject.title: Framing of the founding poem
subject.statement: The founding poem uses a ten-dollar domain registration as an image for Charitology’s invitation to study how generosity is aimed.
subject.context: *Editorial note: This manifesto is a poem, not a history of philanthropy. The ten-dollar image is the author’s account of a domain registration. Existing philanthropy, ethics and evaluation fields have long studied giving; the poem’s invitation is to develop and test Charitology’s proposed shared craft.*
